structuredData.headline: Sanderling Contemporary Elegance — Classic Condominium Renovation at Lakefront Residence, Cyberjaya
structuredData.description: A 950 sqft 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom condominium at Sanderling Lakefront Residence in Cyberjaya renovated on an RM 65,000 budget. Features soft cream wainscoting throughout, beveled diamond-grid accent mirrors, classical wall moulding, gold-trimmed upholstered master bed, custom entryway cabinetry, and built-in mirrored wardrobes.
